title: Value under a constant clone assignment
statement: Let $E$ be a finite weighted constraint experiment, let $M>0$, and let $a$ assign a value to each variable. Extend $a$ to variable-clone pairs by giving every clone of a variable the same value. The value of the cloned experiment under this extended assignment equals the value of $E$ under $a$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of values to variables is given
